messages:
Sam: quick heads-up: int4 nightly bring-up failing on long-context stress (>64k). repro harness shows token-level divergence after ~98k tokens. saving logs.
Laura: ugh. which model and quant config?
Sam: magnet13b-int4 (quant scheme v2), rc kernel: runtime/kv_v2. Command I ran:
```
./tools/longctx_fuzz.py --model=magnet13b --quant=int4v2 --ctx=131072 --seed=42 --mode=kv-shadow
```
Sam: output snippet (diff-style):
```
--- baseline (fp16)
+++ int4v2
@@
 token 98123: "the" vs "teh"
 token 98124: logits shifted by ~0.9
```
Sam: attached full dump to /tmp/kv-dumps/1769154321.tar.gz :eyes: 
Jyoti: seen similar once when rotary scale missed wrap correction. do you have rotary_scale param? what's pos_embed mode?
Sam: rotary_scale=1.0, pos_embed=rope, no dynamic scaling. tried with rotary_scale=1.0001 and the mismatch persists.
Marco: can you try with --kv-prefill=off? if prefill and streaming interleave, index math can shift.
Sam: ran that: same divergence but shifted earlier (token ~73k). logs show kvcache indices occasionally decrementing by 1 around shard boundary.
Jyoti: hypothesis: quant rounding + int4 memcpy alignment + rope phase wrap leads to off-by-one index into KV buffer. Happens at shard boundary when ctx % shard_size ~ small number.
Laura: what's shard_size on dedicated runner? 4096?
Marco: 8192 on new build A. That could explain the offset.
Sam: re-ran with --shard-size=4096 and --kv-prefill=off: divergence moved to token ~86k. still reproducible.
ci-bot: nightly/longctx-int4-fuzz FAILED (run id: 2026-03-15-03)
Jyoti: next steps: (1) add index-asserts around kvcache writes (2) run minimal C test to reproduce memcpy alignment, (3) try keeping fp16 keys but int4 weights to isolate quant path.
Laura: can you open a GH issue with logs + exact binary sha? put it in eng-ml/triage and tag @Marco @Jyoti. include minimal repro command.
Sam: created GH issue #2384: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/2384 — added run artifacts, diffs, and suggested mitigations. assigning to Marco.
Marco: will bisect runtime commits between v2.14..v2.18 and report back tomorrow.
Sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
Laura: :pray: keep updates brief in thread, we'll escalate to eng-runtime if needed.
